scope: Observed long-horizon dynamic qualification of the source-corrected Chen-2012 Lu Caputo contract using the independently validated full-memory ABM oracle.
correction_rationale: The v1 Lu candidate was dynamically strong, but the subsequent source-method audit found that its cited paper did not print a fractional full-memory ABM method or a numerical h. The replacement was chosen for a complete published operator-method-step contract before this corrective trajectory was computed.

decision_rule.qualified: Every resolution passes observed boundedness, activity, the nonperiodicity screen, and within-resolution stability, and the h/2 versus h/4 distributional comparison passes.
decision_rule.not_qualified: Any required dynamic screen or numerical integration fails. A failed screen is reported without changing the criteria.
decision_rule.prerequisite: The separate alternative-system ABM validation report must pass and its oracle, vector-field, candidate-grid, and manifest hashes must match the current inputs.

selection_rule.ranking: Descending minimum normalized continuous acceptance margin among qualified candidates.

does_not_establish: mathematical boundedness outside the observed horizon
a proof of chaos or a positive Lyapunov exponent
pointwise convergence of long chaotic trajectories
equivalence to an embedded finite-memory implementation
automatic inclusion in the primary hardware matrix
